headline: Bitcoin is holding near $61,000 on Monday afternoon in Bangkok after a weekend drop to about $55,100, while Asian stocks slide and US bitcoin funds log a fourth straight week of outflows before a short US holiday week.

market.asOf: BTC about $61,400 at about 06:30 UTC Mon 23 Nov (13:30 Bangkok) per Bitcoin.com News; ETH $1,724.15 at 00:00 UTC per KuCoin's daily report. The price sites could not be read directly this run, so use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 11 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear"), per Bitcoin.com News on 23 Nov; the index page itself could not be opened this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $61,000 as Asian stocks slide
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to about $55,100 on Saturday and climbed back above $61,000 late Sunday. On Monday, South Korea's main stock index fell 5% at the open, triggering a brief halt on program selling, after the Nasdaq 100's worst week since March 2020. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index is still at "Extreme Fear".
points: Bitcoin was about $61,400, up about 4% in 24 hours, after a 21 Nov low of $55,130, per Bitcoin.com News (1:30am ET Monday).
Bitcoin is down about 21.5% so far in November and about 52% below its $126,080 all-time high, per Bitcoin.com News.
South Korea's KOSPI fell 5% at Monday's open, triggering a five-minute halt on program selling, per Bitcoin.com News.
Sources disagree on liquidations (forced closing of borrowed bets) in the last 24 hours: about $299 million, 76% of it bets on lower prices, per Stocktwits; about $2.7 billion, per crypto.news.
Holders realized more than $11.3 billion of losses over 7 days, per KuCoin's daily market report.

stories.title: $1.79 billion left US bitcoin funds last week, with a crowded holiday week ahead
stories.summary: About $1.79 billion left US spot bitcoin funds last week, the fourth losing week in a row. This short Thanksgiving week brings US inflation data on Wednesday, with traders widely expecting the Fed to raise rates in December, and a large monthly bitcoin options expiry on Friday.
points: About $1.79 billion left US spot bitcoin ETFs in the week of 16-20 Nov, led by BlackRock's IBIT at about $1.37 billion, per CoinCentral citing SoSoValue.
Friday 20 Nov alone saw a $669 million outflow, the fourth day of outflows in a row, per SoSoValue data reported on KuCoin.
US spot ether ETFs lost about $314 million, their eighth losing week in a row, per Bitcoin Foundation news.
October PCE inflation comes out Wed 25 Nov; core PCE is expected at 3.2% a year against 3.1% before, per Newsquawk.
CME FedWatch showed a 93.2% chance of a quarter-point December rate hike, down from 99%, per KuCoin (23 Nov).

sources.label: KuCoin: $669M bitcoin ETF outflow on 20 Nov
Bitcoin Foundation: ether ETFs extend losing streak
KuCoin: December hike odds drop to 93.2%

stories.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy bitcoin buy a week before its index removal
stories.summary: Strategy, the company that holds 850,849 bitcoin, may announce another purchase: chairman Michael Saylor posted "The dots aren't done", a line that has come before past purchase filings, but no new buy is confirmed. At current prices its bitcoin is worth less than it paid, and it leaves the MSCI indexes after the 30 Nov close.
points: Strategy holds 850,849 BTC bought for about $64.2 billion, an average of $75,452 each, per CoinCentral.
At about $60,424 per bitcoin those coins were worth about $51.4 billion, roughly $12.8 billion below cost, per CoinCentral.
Its last confirmed purchase was 485 BTC for $33.4 million during 9-15 Nov, per CoinCentral.
MSCI's removal takes effect at the close on 30 Nov; CoinCentral notes it does not force Strategy to sell bitcoin.

briefs.title: Chainflip hack bounty deadline is today
briefs.summary: Chainflip offers the attacker a 10% bounty if 110.575 BTC and 2,618.1 ETH come back by 18:38 UTC Mon 23 Nov (01:38 Tue Bangkok); no return was confirmed as of Monday morning, per SpazioCrypto.

briefs.title: Kalshi faces a New York court hearing today
briefs.summary: Justice Melissa Crane hears New York Attorney General Letitia James's renewed restraining-order request against Kalshi at 11:30am ET Mon 23 Nov (23:30 Bangkok), per Inside Bitcoins.

briefs.title: Monad's first big team and investor unlock is Tuesday
briefs.summary: About 16.61 billion MON unlocks on Tue 24 Nov for team, investors and treasury, per Coinranking using CryptoRank; DefiLlama puts it at 17.1 billion. See the unlock table for this desk's size and confidence.

briefs.title: Fusionist's ACE bridge losses put at about $5.7 million
briefs.summary: An attacker misused a minting role to create unbacked ACE on BNB Chain; about $5.7 million was lost in total and Bithumb suspended ACE, per ChangeNOW.

briefs.title: Cyber bridge exploit pauses transfers in Korea
briefs.summary: About 5.2 million CYBER was minted unexpectedly on Solana and the same amount left its Ethereum bridge; Upbit and Bithumb suspended deposits and withdrawals while Cyber investigates, per Cryptonews.com.au.

briefs.title: UK plans to bar exchanges from market making on their own platforms
briefs.summary: The FCA's proposed rule would apply when the UK crypto regime goes live on 25 Oct 2027, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Russia opens the door to crypto trading on domestic exchanges
briefs.summary: A Bank of Russia rule took effect on 22 Nov; Moscow Exchange targets a 1 Dec pilot, and retail buyers are capped at 300,000 rubles a year per broker, limited to BTC, ETH and USDT, per Coinidol.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (updated estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: Core PCE is expected at 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), per Newsquawk, which notes Fed Governor Bowman suggested core reached 3.3%. Q3 GDP is expected at 3.5% after 3.4%, durable goods at 0.5% after 1.9%, and weekly jobless claims at 201K after 203K, per FXEmpire.
Per FXEmpire. New home sales come out earlier the same day at 10:00am ET (22:00 Bangkok); 649K is expected after 676K, per FXEmpire.
US stock markets are closed; on Friday 27 Nov stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok).

calendar.event: Monthly bitcoin options expiry on Deribit
calendar.note: About $6.76 billion of bitcoin options (112,323 BTC) expire, with the "max pain" level at $73,000, per Cryptoticker using Deribit data from 21 Nov; CoinOtag (22 Nov) puts it at about $6.6 billion.
